item.title: The Film the BBC Wouldn’t Air
item.description: Two veteran journalists set out to document Israel’s destruction of Gaza’s health care system: hospitals attacked, medical workers killed, doctors detained and held for long periods without criminal charges. The BBC had commissioned the film. But their Palestinian sources in Gaza and the West Bank were skeptical. “We really had to try and persuade them…to talk to us because they didn’t—and don’t—trust the BBC,” says reporter Ramita Navai. item.title: Sérgio & Odair Assad at 92NY
item.description: Sérgio & Odair Assad at 92NYMar. 14. 7:30PM. $45+up In the 1980s, the Brazilian guitar duo of Sérgio & Odair Assad released an album of music by Argentine tango composer Astor Piazzolla. Within a few years, the Assad Brothers were the most sought-after guitar duo in the world. They’ve won Grammys, played with leading classical musicians like Yo-Yo Ma, and greatly expanded the repertoire for two guitars.
